fields.narration: STARTEX. This is an exercise. It is 07:00 on Monday, October 5, 2026, in Fort Dodge, Webster County, Iowa. A regional line of storms crossed the Midwest overnight, but Fort Dodge is clearing and cool, and Prairie Ridge Health is starting a normal Monday: the primary wholesaler's 05:30 delivery arrived on schedule, every pharmacy system and cabinet is up, and there are no active shortages on IV fluids. Status is NORMAL. Please confirm your role and where you are working this morning.
